column8: {α : Type} → Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.Framed α → List UInt8 → Option α
∀ {α : Type} (framed : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.Framed α) {bytes : List UInt8} {value : α}, framed.decode bytes = Option.some value → framed.encode value = bytes
∀ {α : Type} (framed : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.Framed α) (value : α), framed.decode (framed.encode value) = Option.some value

∀ {α : Type} (framed : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.Framed α) {other : List UInt8}, other ≠ framed.frame → ∀ (tail : List UInt8), framed.decode (Minidregg.Compiler.Tower256ConcreteBackend.bytesStream.encode other ++ tail) = Option.none

{motive : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.OpenError → Sort u} → (t : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.OpenError) → t.ctorIdx = 3 → motive Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.OpenError.badMac → motive t

{motive : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.OpenError → Sort u} → (t : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.OpenError) → t.ctorIdx = 1 → motive Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.OpenError.foreignKey → motive t

{motive : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.OpenError → Sort u} → (t : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.OpenError) → t.ctorIdx = 0 → motive Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.OpenError.malformed → motive t

{motive : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.OpenError → Sort u} → (t : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.OpenError) → t.ctorIdx = 2 → motive Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.OpenError.rootMismatch → motive t

{motive : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.SeedEpoch → Sort u} → (t : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.SeedEpoch) → t.ctorIdx = 2 → motive Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.SeedEpoch.foreign → motive t

{motive : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.SeedEpoch → Sort u} → (t : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.SeedEpoch) → t.ctorIdx = 0 → ((epoch : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.StoreEpoch) → motive (Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.SeedEpoch.labelled epoch)) → motive t

{motive : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.SeedEpoch → Sort u} → (t : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.SeedEpoch) → t.ctorIdx = 1 → ((version : UInt8) → motive (Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.SeedEpoch.unlabelled version)) → motive t

∀ (host : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.StoreEpoch) (accumulator : String), accumulator ≠ host.accumulator → { stateKey := host.stateKey, schemaRefs := host.schemaRefs, logTag := host.logTag, accumulator := accumulator }.differing host = [ToString.toString "history accumulator: Store " ++ ToString.toString accumulator ++ ToString.toString ", this Host " ++ ToString.toString host.accumulator]

∀ (host : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.StoreEpoch) (logTag : String), logTag ≠ host.logTag → { stateKey := host.stateKey, schemaRefs := host.schemaRefs, logTag := logTag, accumulator := host.accumulator }.differing host = [ToString.toString "log tags: Store " ++ ToString.toString logTag ++ ToString.toString ", this Host " ++ ToString.toString host.logTag]

∀ (host : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.StoreEpoch) (schemaRefs : String), schemaRefs ≠ host.schemaRefs → { stateKey := host.stateKey, schemaRefs := schemaRefs, logTag := host.logTag, accumulator := host.accumulator }.differing host = [ToString.toString "cell schema references: Store " ++ ToString.toString schemaRefs ++ ToString.toString ", this Host " ++ ToString.toString host.schemaRefs]

∀ (host : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.StoreEpoch) (stateKey : String), stateKey ≠ host.stateKey → { stateKey := stateKey, schemaRefs := host.schemaRefs, logTag := host.logTag, accumulator := host.accumulator }.differing host = [ToString.toString "state-key codec: Store " ++ ToString.toString stateKey ++ ToString.toString ", this Host " ++ ToString.toString host.stateKey]

∀ (start : Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest) (left right : List Minidregg.Kernel.DurableReceiver.IntentRecord), Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.chainAfter start (left ++ right) = Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.chainAfter (Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.chainAfter start left) right

∀ (key : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.MacKey) (rootBytes : List UInt8 → Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest) (sealed : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.Sealed), sealed.mac ≠ Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.checkpointMac key sealed.body sealed.root → ∃ reason, Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.openSealed key rootBytes (Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.checkpointFrame.encode sealed) = Except.error reason ∧ reason ≠ Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.OpenError.malformed

∀ (key other : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.MacKey) (rootBytes : List UInt8 → Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest) (height : ℕ) (chain : Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest) (frontier : List (ℕ × Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest)) (spentRoot : Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest) (state : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableCheckpoint.State), other.id ≠ key.id → Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.openSealed key rootBytes (Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.checkpointFrame.encode (Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.sealCheckpoint other rootBytes height chain frontier spentRoot state)) = Except.error Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.OpenError.foreignKey

∀ (key : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.MacKey) (rootBytes : List UInt8 → Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest) (height : ℕ) (chain : Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest) (frontier : List (ℕ × Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest)) (spentRoot : Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest) (state : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableCheckpoint.State), Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.openSealed key rootBytes (Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.checkpointFrame.encode (Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.sealCheckpoint key rootBytes height chain frontier spentRoot state)) = Except.ok { keyId := key.id, height := height, chain := chain, frontier := frontier, spentRoot := spentRoot, state := state }

∀ (key : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.MacKey) (rootBytes : List UInt8 → Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest) (height : ℕ) (chain : Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest) (frontier : List (ℕ × Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest)) (spentRoot : Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest) (state : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableCheckpoint.State) {root : Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest}, root = Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.worldRoot rootBytes { keyId := key.id, height := height, chain := chain, frontier := frontier, spentRoot := spentRoot, state := state } → Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.sealAt key height chain frontier spentRoot state root = Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.sealCheckpoint key rootBytes height chain frontier spentRoot state

∀ (rest : List UInt8), ∃ named, (Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.SeedEpoch.ofBytes (Minidregg.Compiler.Tower256ConcreteBackend.bytesStream.encode (Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.seedFrameName ++ [1]) ++ rest)).refusal = Option.some named
